name: Farmhouse
description: Owner review 2: window panes are now genuinely see-through. Only Mesh_ShellGlass material changed: portable core-glTF alpha BLEND glass (kiln.material.glass.v1 recipe, tint #a9cdd4, opacity 0.14, roughness 0.05, metalness 0, single-sided on closed pane boxes); no transmission extension. All geometry, transforms, door pivot, frames, shutters, roof, ceiling and porch soffit preserved. Model claude-opus-5-5 via Claude Code; High effort requested, not independently confirmed. Candidate awaiting owner review.
